title: Frog Snake Turtle Song
hook: Look at the adaptation; leave the animal space.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat between cue and confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D frogs-snakes-turtles storybook, friendly rounded reptiles and amphibians, simple pond-and-log setting

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing defensive structures from safe images
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written adaptations; danger not dramatized as play
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: defense cue -> recall beat -> target -> abstract shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a muted shaker hiss-shape and marimba step after the word, never a realistic snake hiss bed.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a muted shaker hiss-shape and marimba step after the word, never a realistic snake hiss bed
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Frog Snake Turtle Song a body-defense and safety comparison: constriction, venom, shell, camouflage, frill, gripping toes and moist skin are distinct adaptations, with no child imitation of attack behavior.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child reads defense/feeding structures from pictures and keeps dangerous animals at visual distance.
